# Pull Request

Thanks for contributing to **Hoplane by Kitgenix**. Please describe what changed, why it matters, and how you tested it. Review [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Kitgenix/hoplane/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md), [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Kitgenix/hoplane/blob/main/SECURITY.md), and the project [LICENSE](https://github.com/Kitgenix/hoplane/blob/main/LICENSE) before submitting.

> **Security vulnerabilities:** Do not disclose an unpatched vulnerability in a public pull request or issue. Use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Kitgenix/hoplane/security/advisories/new) instead.
